assertion_results.text: Data extraction identifies the ecosystem as RPM based on the library name (openssl-libs) and component context, not Cargo (Step 1 Ecosystem detection — read ecosystems from Ecosystem Mappings config)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md line 30-31: 'Vulnerable library | openssl-libs' and 'Ecosystem | RPM (system package; lock file `rpms.lock.yaml` configured in Ecosystem Mappings)'. Cargo is not mentioned anywhere in the outputs; version-impact.md line 5: 'Ecosystem mapping: RPM -> `rpms.lock.yaml`'.

assertion_results.text: Version impact table includes ALL versions from the 2.2.x stream supportability matrix (2.2.0 through 2.2.4) and uses rpms.lock.yaml data for version extraction (Step 2.3)

assertion_results.text: Dependency chain context identifies openssl-libs as present in rpms.lock.yaml and uses this to determine the package origin — the lock file presence is the primary classification signal (Step 2.3.5)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md lines 33-36: 'rpms.lock.yaml: present at v0.4.5 (3.0.7-25.el9_3) and v0.4.8 (3.0.7-27.el9_4) → explicit install' and 'Origin: explicit install (openssl-libs is pinned in rpms.lock.yaml...)'; line 51: 'The explicit-install classification comes from rpms.lock.yaml alone.'

assertion_results.text: Remediation creates a single task for the Konflux release repo — not the two-task upstream backport + downstream propagation flow used for source dependency ecosystems (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation — system package path)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md line 14: 'Ecosystem RPM (system package) -> **1 task** for the 2.2.x stream (Konflux release repo fix). No upstream backport task.' Single task 'Remediation Task (2.2.x)' with Repository rhtpa-release.0.4.z. version-impact.md line 60: 'RPM has no upstream source branch, so the remediation is a Konflux release repo change only.' (The conditional 2.1.x preemptive task is a separate cross-stream Case A item, not an upstream/downstream pair.)

assertion_results.text: Remediation task description follows task-description-template.md format with Repository, Target Branch, Description, Implementation Notes, and Acceptance Criteria sections — Files to Modify is intentionally omitted per remediation-templates.md (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md description block contains '## Repository' (line 29), '## Target Branch' (line 33), '## Description' (line 37), '## Implementation Notes' (line 54), '## Acceptance Criteria' (line 68), plus Test Requirements and Dependencies. No 'Files to Modify' section appears.
